description: Implement domain models, Supabase SQL migrations, RLS policies, infrastructure layer with auth/persistence/billing/mail adapters, config boundary, and the full provider integration layer. Corresponds to subtasks 2.2 and 2.3.
steps: Create domain/ directory with entity types: Tenant (id, name, slug, ownerId, createdAt, updatedAt), Membership (id, tenantId, userId, role: owner|admin|member, createdAt), Project (id, tenantId, name, description, createdAt, updatedAt), Subscription (id, tenantId, stripeCustomerId, stripeSubscriptionId, stripePriceId, status: active|past_due|cancelled|trialing, currentPeriodEnd, cancelAtPeriodEnd, createdAt, updatedAt)

Create domain/policies.ts with deny-by-default Authorizer implementations: canAccessTenant, canManageTenant, canAccessProject, canManageMembers - checking ownership/membership/role at repository boundary

Create supabase/migrations/ directory with numbered SQL migration files: 001_tenants.sql, 002_memberships.sql, 003_projects.sql, 004_subscriptions.sql, 005_processed_events.sql - each with table creation, indexes, RLS enable, and RLS policies for tenant isolation

Each migration must include: UUID primary keys (gen_random_uuid()), tenant_id ownership columns, created_at/updated_at timestamps with defaults, version/updated_at concurrency columns, RLS enabled, policies for authenticated user tenant access

Create lib/server/config.ts with typed ConfigSpec declarations for all env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STRIPE_PRICE_ID, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL), aggregate validation at startup that refuses if required server-only values are missing/placeholder

Create lib/server/auth.ts implementing IdentityPort interface using Supabase Auth (@supabase/ssr for server-side session): getSession, getUser, requireAuth (throws if unauthenticated), with AuthContext type

Create lib/server/database.ts implementing Repository interfaces for Tenant, Membership, Project, Subscription using Supabase Postgres client with RLS-enforced queries, transaction support, and sanitized error mapping

Create lib/server/billing.ts implementing BillingPort with Stripe adapter: createCustomer, createCheckoutSession, createBillingPortalSession, getSubscription, handleWebhookEvent. Include WebhookVerifier that verifies stripe-signature header with raw body before any state transition. Implement idempotent event processing via ProcessedEvent table (provider_event_id unique). Handle subscription states: checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted for entitlement/renewal/cancellation

Create lib/server/mail.ts implementing MailPort with Resend adapter: sendWelcomeEmail, sendInviteEmail. Include preview/fake mode when RESEND_API_KEY is placeholder or missing (logs email content instead of sending)

Create lib/server/billing-fake.ts and lib/server/mail-fake.ts with deterministic in-memory fake implementations for testing - FakeBillingPort stores events in memory, FakeMailPort captures sent emails
Create lib/server/providers.ts that selects real vs fake adapters based on config (fake when env vars are placeholder values)
Ensure all provider errors are mapped to sanitized domain errors (no stack traces, no secret leakage in error messages)
Add @supabase/supabase-js, @supabase/ssr, stripe, resend as exact-pinned dependencies in package.json and regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml
acceptance_criteria: domain/ contains typed entity interfaces for Tenant, Membership, Project, Subscription with all required fields
supabase/migrations/ contains SQL files that create all tables with RLS policies
lib/server/config.ts aggregates all missing required env vars into one startup error
lib/server/auth.ts implements Supabase Auth session retrieval
lib/server/billing.ts implements Stripe webhook verification with raw body before state mutation, idempotent event processing, and subscription state management
lib/server/mail.ts implements Resend with fake fallback when API key is missing/placeholder
All provider adapters have fake counterparts for testing
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds with the new dependencies
pnpm run build succeeds (TypeScript compiles without errors)
